story.logline: A gravely serious documentary crew treats Paper Sapling as the most consequential event of the decade.
story.dramaticQuestion: Does Paper Sapling still hold once the rule of the world changes?

beats.purpose: Interrupt with the strangest true image of the idea

camera.movement: locked tripod with a slow settle

physics: sapling holds its mass and does not drift between beats
contact between hand and object deforms both believably
any settling motion decays under gravity rather than stopping abruptly

continuityLocks: paper base position, geometry and finish unchanged
light direction and screen direction unchanged
imperfectionAnchors: dust settled along a single seam
a faint fingerprint on the nearest surface
an uneven patina where the object is handled most

soundDesignDirectives: close handling contact on the hero object
low room tone with no music bed

exclusions: no invented signage, logos, or on-screen text
